## Current objective
Add a CSV vendor-credit importer at `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py` for finance this week. SQLAlchemy and GitHub Actions migrations are superseded/paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Use CI runner `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded. Search rebuild uses tenant-scoped queries and `CHUNK_SIZE = 100` with eight embedding workers.

## Ruled-out approaches
Sequential per-invoice embedding was too slow; unbatched concurrent requests changed client call shape. Raising Celery visibility timeout concealed stuck jobs.

## Plan and progress
Pending: inspect existing import conventions, implement vendor-credit CSV validation/mapping, add tests, then run focused/full checks. Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`. SQLAlchemy work is on hold; GHA migration status is unknown.

## Recent work
Search indexing was optimized from 8.42s to 1.19s for 5,000 invoices, with 33 relevant tests passing. Webhook retries also passed all 44 tests.
